source_title: Richard Simmons' Hollywood Hills home sells for $3.8m after $6.99m listing
source_excerpt: The Sunset Strip estate in Los Angeles, where fitness guru Richard Simmons lived for decades, has sold for $3.827 million, a TMZ report confirmed. The Hollywood Hills estate, which features a Colonial-style home, initially asked $6.99 million. The new owner plans to restore the home, listing agents Rachelle Rosten and Kelly deLaat of Douglas Elliman told the outlet. The buyer has not been publicly identified.The property first went on the market in June 2025 with an asking price of $6.99 million, Realtor.com reported. This was about a year after Simmons died. The house drew interest; however, none of it resulted in a deal. An earlier sale went into escrow at $5.889 million but fell apart in December. The seller cut the price to $5.799 million, and another buyer signed a contract in May. The final price came in nearly $2 million below that reduced asking price.A home with a famous pedigreeThe fitness guru owned the home for decades. Simmons bought it in the 1980s and stayed for more than four decades. He preferred to maintain his privacy in his final years and loved spending time in the Colonial-style home. Simmons died in July 2024, just days after his 76th birthday.Like many other prospective buyers, the new owner was attracted by the home's pedigree.
